name: Misshitsu no Sacrifice ~Jitka: Aru Heisa Shisetsu kara no Dasshutsu~
original_name: 密室のサクリファイス ～イトカ：ある閉鎖施設からの脱出～
source:
Jitka, one of the characters from D3 Publisher’s trap adventure game Misshitsu no Sacrifice, has awoken from a cold sleep and she’s trapped in an underground facility. In Misshitu no Sacrifice Jitka: Escape from a Locked Facility you have to help her get out.

[From [url=http://www.siliconera.com/2010/09/22/this-is-jitka-will-you-help-her-escape-from-a-locked-facility/]Siliconera[/url]]

This spin off plays like a "locked room" style game, with a focus on ecchi unlike it's predecessor.
translation:
Jitka是D3 Publisher的陷阱冒险游戏《Mishitsu no Sacrifice》中的角色之一，她从寒冷的睡眠中醒来，她被困在一个地下设施中。在《Mishitu no Sacrifice Jitka: Escape from a Locked Facility》中，你必须帮助她逃出去。

[来自[url=http://www.siliconera.com/2010/09/22/this-is-jitka-will-you-help-her-escape-from-a-locked-facility/]Siliconera[/url]]

这款衍生游戏的玩法类似于“上锁的房间”风格的游戏，与前作不同的是，它的重点是“ecchi”。
